rows.note: Use this everyday noun when the focus is on recalling past experiences or memories.

example.english: I often engage in retrospection about the days I lived in the countryside as a child.
example.traditional: 我成日回憶細個喺鄉下住嘅日子。
example.jyutping: ngo5 seng4 jat6 wui4 jik1 sai3 go3 hai2 hoeng1 haa2 zyu6 ge3 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this when the focus is deliberately looking back over past events as a whole.

example.english: At the year-end review, the manager led everyone in retrospection on the company’s development over the past year.
example.traditional: 年終總結會上，經理帶住大家回顧公司過去一年嘅發展。
example.jyutping: nin4 zung1 zung2 git3 wui6 soeng6 ging1 lei5 daai2 zyu6 daai6 gaa1 wui4 gu3 gung1 si1 gwo3 heoi3 jat1 nin4 ge3 faat3 zin2
